title: Prop
description: Prop bible (production/props/<PROP_ID>/prop.yaml): canonical description, hands needed to hold it, and reference assets. Custody is tracked in the panel ledger.

id.description: Prop ID, e.g. PROP_FLARE_GUN. Matches the directory name.

description.description: Canonical description. Prompts are compiled from these fields.

distinguishing_features.description: Shape and details that keep it the same object across panels.

prompt_summary.description: One generation-ready sentence used verbatim in prompts.

hands_required.description: Hands needed to hold it; counted against the two-hand budget.

plot_relevant.description: true = the story depends on where this prop is.

references.description: Asset IDs registered in references/manifest.yaml. May be empty.

status.description: Approval status of the bible entry.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
